dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: In terms familiar to a human, Sorush has matured from her recent experiences.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: The Pari are indifferent to the maturation process, but I didn't realize that Sorush had already...

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Hm. It's been a good thing for her. That should mean enough.
